forbidden.name: no-inward-deps-on-consumers
forbidden.comment: network-config is the shared layer: it must not depend on the CLI. It is also published on its own, so a consumer can take the library without the tool — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

forbidden.name: no-deep-cross-package-imports
forbidden.comment: Cross-package imports go through the package's public surface, never a deep path. A deep import binds a consumer to internals that move without notice.
